must_confirm: D03 owns data quality validation; D04 only consumes quality_flag
D04 stores, indexes and retrieves L1/L2/L3 data; it does not perform unified interpretation
L1 JSON, L2 SQLite and L3 JSON archive layering is acceptable
quality_flag priority complete > pending_review > unverified > invalid is acceptable
temporary or newly backfilled data cannot enter analysis conclusions before validation
fallback and freshness degradation rules are acceptable
D04 capability boundary does not conflict with D01/D03/D05/D06/D07/D08
UnifiedDataSource as L0 infrastructure requires V1-V7 validation before production use
capability_registry may register C-D04-0001 only after Phase 2 entry criteria are met
temporary D04-held items compute_factor_ic, compare_current_vs_historical and get_max_drawdown have Phase 3 migration review paths
rollback and Golden Master requirements are sufficient
new D04 interfaces must follow the D04 demand change flow
D07 unified interpretation needs historical percentile, score history and risk-history access
D04 output is data service only and does not replace investment interpretation
D04 activation should improve daily, weekly, deep and ad-hoc analysis evidence quality
